app.name: Xero
app.description: Xero is cloud-based accounting software designed for small and medium-sized businesses.

notes: Tested: a custom auth config created without `oauth_redirect_uri` sends `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add`. Register exactly the URI your auth config sends, or set `oauth_redirect_uri` to `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback` and register that instead.
Composio sends users to `https://login.xero.com/identity/connect/authorize` by default.
Default requested scopes include comprehensive accounting, files, projects, and user profile scopes.
Setting `oauth_redirect_uri` to `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback` switches the callback destination correctly.

assumption: An agent that reads and manages accounting data (invoices, contacts, bank transactions) across arbitrary customer Xero organizations.

verdict.headline: Self-serve OAuth setup allows testing up to 5 connections for free, but scaling requires a paid developer tier and security assessment.
verdict.summary: Developers can immediately register an app at developer.xero.com and obtain credentials for testing with up to 5 organization connections. Scaling beyond 5 connections requires subscribing to a paid developer tier (starting at $35 AUD/month). Full certification and App Store listing require 10 active beta customers and passing a security assessment.

handsOnEffort.label: 2–5 hours
handsOnEffort.basis: Configuring OAuth credentials, setting up redirect URIs, and completing security self-assessments.

timeToFirstConnection.label: 15–30 min
timeToFirstConnection.basis: Immediate app creation on developer portal provides live credentials for up to 5 test connections.

timeToProduction.label: 1–3 weeks
timeToProduction.basis: Instant tier upgrade for connection limits; 1–3 weeks to onboard 10 beta users and pass security assessment for certification.

verdict.longestPole: Onboarding 10 active beta customer connections and completing the security assessment for app certification.
verdict.costDetail: Free Starter tier allows up to 5 active organization connections. Paid plans start at $35 AUD/mo (Core, up to 50 connections) and scale to $1,445 AUD/mo (Advanced, up to 10,000 connections). Egress overage costs $2.40 AUD per GB.

easierPaths.effect: Operate completely on the free Starter tier without paid plans or certification.

factors.detail: Developers can register an app immediately at developer.xero.com to obtain Client ID and Secret.
App certification and security reviews are required to publish on the Xero App Store.
Business verification and application details are inspected during app certification.
Initial security assessment is required for app certification.
Free Starter tier is limited to 5 connections. Core tier costs $35 AUD/month for up to 50 connections.
Paid developer plans (Core, Plus, Advanced) are available self-serve without sales contact.
Free Starter tier limits app connections to 5 organizations.
Standard OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow where end-users grant tenant access.

phases.title: Register App
phases.outcome: Xero developer account created and OAuth application registered with a Client ID and Client Secret.

steps.title: Create a Xero Developer Account
steps.details: Navigate to the Xero Developer Portal, sign in or create an account, and complete developer terms acceptance.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can bookmark the sign-up page and draft organization contact details.

steps.title: Register a New App
steps.details: In the **Developer Console**, click **New App**. Fill in the app name, company URL, privacy policy URL, and terms of service URL.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can draft the app name, terms of service, and privacy policy text.

phases.title: Configure Redirect URIs and Credentials
phases.outcome: Absolute redirect URIs registered and Client ID / Client Secret generated.

steps.title: Configure Redirect URIs
steps.details: Go to **Configuration** in your app settings. Add `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add` or `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback` as an absolute redirect URI (wildcards are not supported; up to 50 allowed).
steps.agentAssist: An agent can verify the exact Composio callback URLs to input.

steps.title: Generate Client Secret
steps.details: Click **Generate a secret** under your app credentials. Copy the Client ID and Client Secret immediately.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can prepare secure vault environment variables to receive these keys.

phases.title: Test with Test Organizations
phases.outcome: OAuth flow verified using free Starter tier connections.

steps.title: Connect Test Organizations
steps.details: Initiate the OAuth flow using your credentials. Connect up to 5 test organizations available under the free Starter tier.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can trigger an authorization request URL test to check error handling.

phases.title: Prepare for Review and App Certification
phases.outcome: 10 active beta customers onboarded and security assessment documentation compiled.

steps.title: Upgrade Developer Plan and Onboard Beta Users
steps.details: Upgrade to a paid developer tier (Core at $35 AUD/mo or higher) and ensure at least 10 active customer organizations are using your integration within a 30-day window.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can track active API call logs to confirm customer activity.

steps.title: Complete Security Assessment
steps.details: Fill out the Xero partner security questionnaire and ensure compliance with Xero security standards for API consumers.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can draft answers regarding data handling, encryption, and storage policies.

phases.title: Review and Approval
phases.outcome: App certified and approved for wide distribution.

steps.title: Submit for App Certification
steps.details: Xero reviews your application, verifies beta customer usage, and inspects security questionnaire responses.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can check submission status and track reviewer comments.

phases.title: Go live in Composio
phases.outcome: Custom Xero OAuth configuration active inside Composio toolkit.

steps.title: Create Custom Auth Config in Composio
steps.details: Call Composio API or use settings UI to create a custom OAuth configuration for `xero` passing your Client ID, Client Secret, and scopes.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can execute the API call to create the custom auth config automatically using your provided credentials.

steps.title: Initiate Connection Session
steps.details: Pass the custom auth config ID into your Composio connection request to authenticate end-users against Xero.
steps.agentAssist: An agent can generate the connection link for your users.

requirements.detail: Self-serve registration at developer.xero.com to manage OAuth applications.
Register up to 50 exact URIs (wildcards strictly prohibited).
Subscribe to Core ($35 AUD/mo), Plus ($245 AUD/mo), or higher plan to expand beyond 5 organization connections.
Requirement of 10 active organizations using the app within 30 days prior to applying for app certification.
Pass Xero security standards questionnaire for partner app certification.

scopes.purpose: Receive refresh tokens for long-term access without requiring prompt re-authentication.
scopes.note: Required for backend integrations; access tokens expire in 30 minutes.

scopes.purpose: Read and write invoice documents across authorized organizations.
scopes.note: Granular scope model applies for new apps created on or after March 2, 2026.

scopes.purpose: Read and write customer and supplier contacts.
Read and create bank transaction records.

blockers.title: Redirect URI Mismatch
blockers.symptom: OAuth authorization fails immediately with an invalid redirect_uri error.
blockers.howToProceed: Ensure the exact callback URL configured in Composio matches the redirect URI registered in the Xero Developer Console. Wildcards are not permitted.

blockers.title: Insufficient Scope Error
blockers.howToProceed: Verify that your app requests the necessary granular scopes (introduced March 2026) and that user has re-authenticated if scope requirements changed.

blockers.title: Connection Limit Reached
blockers.symptom: Calls fail or registration blocks new customer connections beyond 5 organizations.
blockers.howToProceed: Upgrade your developer tier from Starter to Core ($35 AUD/mo) or higher in the Xero developer console to increase connection capacity.

nuances.title: Token Lifetimes & Refresh Rotation
nuances.detail: Access tokens expire after 30 minutes. Refresh tokens expire after 60 days of non-use, and each refresh returns a new refresh token that must be stored immediately.

nuances.title: Granular Scopes Policy
nuances.detail: Granular scopes are mandatory for apps created on or after March 2, 2026. Existing apps have until September 2027 to migrate from broad scopes.

nuances.title: AI/ML Data Training Ban
nuances.detail: Xero Developer Terms explicitly prohibit using API data to train artificial intelligence or machine learning models.

nuances.title: Rate Limits per Organization
nuances.detail: Each tenant/organization connection is capped at 5 concurrent requests, 60 requests per minute, and 5,000 requests per day (Starter plan restricted to 1,000 requests/day/org). App-wide minute limit is 10,000 requests/min.

steps: Navigate to your Xero Developer Portal and obtain your Client ID and Client Secret.
Use the Composio API or dashboard to create a custom OAuth configuration for the `xero` toolkit.
Provide your custom Xero Client ID and Client Secret to the Composio auth configuration.
Ensure `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add` or `https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback` is registered as the redirect URI in Xero.
Pass the custom auth configuration ID when initiating user connection sessions.
